**Finding: Missing — vendor insurance (INSURANCE, severity low)**

The Agreement has no insurance provision at all. Searches for "insurance" and "indemn" return zero hits, and Section 10 (General Provisions) runs only through 10.8 (Headings; Counterparts).

HDI is squarely a hosting/services vendor under the playbook trigger:
- §1.4 — HDI stores and operates the Site on its own computer system;
- §1.5 / §2.2 — HDI generates order export/import files and processes customer orders;
- §8.1 — HDI has access to Content, user information and data of the Company.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 10.9 inserted after p0070, requiring HDI to carry CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M, cyber liability of USD 5M covering its processing of Confidential Information, Content and customer/user data, and statutory workers' compensation, for the term plus one year, with certificates on request. Placement in Section 10 also picks up the two-year survival in §10.7.

The comment flags our fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) in case HDI pushes back on the cyber limit.
